title: Improper access control in the Web Admin console of Progress Software WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.7 and…
description: An improper access control vulnerability exists in the Web Admin console of Progress Software WS_FTP Server on Windows. Versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 are affected. This flaw could allow remote unauthenticated attackers to access administrative functionality.
